headline: Chunce Escapes Quantanamo Bay... Again...
standfirst: How does he keep doing this?

body.text: In a bizarre turn of events, Fish News anchor Chunce Whatney has allegedly escaped from Guantanamo Bay, according to completely unverified reports circulating online. Witnesses claim the veteran broadcaster disappeared under the cover of darkness before commandeering a fishing vessel and broadcasting a live weather forecast from international waters.

Authorities have refused to comment on the alleged escape, while social media has been flooded with memes depicting Whatney wearing a suit jacket over an orange jumpsuit and confidently reporting, "Conditions are looking favourable for a successful getaway.

Representatives for Fish News declined to confirm the rumours, stating only that \"Chunce is currently unavailable for this evening's broadcast.\" At the time of publication, officials continued to search for the elusive anchor, though some viewers insist they spotted him presenting the morning tide report from an undisclosed beach.
